019package org.apache.wiki.htmltowiki;
020
021import java.io.IOException;
022import java.io.Writer;
023import java.util.regex.Matcher;
024import java.util.regex.Pattern;
025
026/**
027 * Part of the XHtmlToWikiTranslator.
028 * 
029 */
030// FIXME: Needs a better description as to how it works.
031public class WhitespaceTrimWriter extends Writer {
032
033    private final StringBuffer m_result = new StringBuffer();
034
035    private StringBuffer m_buffer = new StringBuffer();
036
037    private boolean m_trimMode = true;
038
039    public static final String NO_TRIMMED_SPACE = "&nbsp;";
040    private static final Pattern ONLINE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile( ".*?\\n\\s*?", Pattern.MULTILINE );
041
042    private boolean m_currentlyOnLineBegin = true;
043
044    /**
045     *  {@inheritDoc}
046     */
047    @Override
048    public void flush()
049    {
050        if( m_buffer.length() > 0 )
051        {
052            String s = m_buffer.toString();
053            s = s.replaceAll( "\r\n", "\n" );
054            if( m_trimMode )
055            {
056                s = s.replaceAll( "(\\w+) \\[\\?\\|Edit\\.jsp\\?page=\\1\\]", "[$1]" );
057                s = s.replaceAll( "\n{2,}", "\n\n" );
058                s = s.replaceAll( "\\p{Blank}+", " " );
059                s = s.replaceAll( "[ ]*\n[ ]*", "\n" );
060                s = replacePluginNewlineBackslashes( s );
061                s = s.replace( NO_TRIMMED_SPACE, " " );
062            }
063            m_result.append( s );
064            m_buffer = new StringBuffer();
065        }
066    }
067
068    private String replacePluginNewlineBackslashes( String s )
069    {
070        final Pattern p = Pattern.compile( "\\{\\{\\{(.*?)\\}\\}\\}|\\{\\{(.*?)\\}\\}|\\[\\{", Pattern.DOTALL + Pattern.MULTILINE );
071        final Matcher m = p.matcher( s );
072        final StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
073        int pos = 0;
074        while( m.find( pos ) )
075        {
076            final boolean plugin = s.startsWith( "[{", m.start() );
077            final int end = plugin ? endOfPlugin( s, m.start() ) : m.end();
078            if( end < 0 )
079            {
080                sb.append( s, pos, m.end() );
081                pos = m.end();
082                continue;
083            }
084            sb.append( s, pos, m.start() );
085            final String text = s.substring( m.start(), end );
086            sb.append( plugin ? text.replace( "\\\\", "\n" ) : text );
087            pos = end;
088        }
089        sb.append( s, pos, s.length() );
090        return sb.toString();
091    }
092
093    /**
094     *  Returns the index after the closing "}]" of the plugin that starts at {@code start}, counting the plugins nested in it.
095     *  When the brackets do not balance it falls back to the first "}]", and returns -1 when there is none.
096     */
097    private static int endOfPlugin( final String s, final int start )
098    {
099        int depth = 0;
100        for( int i = start; i < s.length() - 1; i++ )
101        {
102            if( s.startsWith( "[{", i ) )
103            {
104                depth++;
105                i++;
106            }
107            else if( s.startsWith( "}]", i ) )
108            {
109                depth--;
110                if( depth == 0 )
111                {
112                    return i + 2;
113                }
114                i++;
115            }
116        }
117        final int first = s.indexOf( "}]", start + 2 );
118        return first < 0 ? -1 : first + 2;
119    }
120
121    /**
122     *  Returns true, if this Writer is currently trimming any whitespaces.
123     *  
124     *  @return True, if trimming.
125     */
126    public boolean isWhitespaceTrimMode()
127    {
128        return m_trimMode;
129    }
130
131    /**
132     *  Set the trimming mode on/off.
133     *  
134     *  @param trimMode True, if you want trimming to be turned on.  False otherwise.
135     */
136    public void setWhitespaceTrimMode(final boolean trimMode )
137    {
138        if( m_trimMode != trimMode )
139        {
140            flush();
141            m_trimMode = trimMode;
142        }
143    }
144
145    /**
146     *  {@inheritDoc}
147     */
148    @Override
149    public void write(final char[] arg0, final int arg1, final int arg2 ) throws IOException
150    {
151        m_buffer.append( arg0, arg1, arg2 );
152        m_currentlyOnLineBegin = ONLINE_PATTERN.matcher( m_buffer ).matches();
153    }
154
155    /**
156     *  {@inheritDoc}
157     */
158    @Override
159    public void close() throws IOException
160    {}
161
162    /**
163     *  {@inheritDoc}
164     */
165    @Override
166    public String toString()
167    {
168        flush();
169        return m_result.toString();
170    }
171
172    /**
173     *  Returns true, if the writer is currently writing a line start.
174     *  
175     *  @return True or false.
176     */
177    public boolean isCurrentlyOnLineBegin()
178    {
179        return m_currentlyOnLineBegin;
180    }
181}
